title: Sri Lanka Group Tour: Sigiriya, Ella and Mirissa
alt: The Nine Arches Bridge curving through the tea hills at Ella
transport: Air conditioned group coach with an English speaking chauffeur and a Hi Tours trip captain

stops.name: Sigiriya
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Twin sharing room · 3★ · Comfortable hotel in the Cultural Triangle near the rock

activities.name: Sigiriya rock fortress guided trek
activities.description: An early guided climb past the water gardens, the mirror wall and the lion paws to the palace ruins on the summit.

activities.name: Dambulla cave temple
activities.description: Five cave shrines carved into the rock, lined with murals and more than a hundred Buddha statues.

program.name: Sigiriya
program.description: One night in the Cultural Triangle with a dawn climb of the rock fortress the next morning.

stops.name: Nuwara Eliya
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Twin sharing room · 3★ · Hill town hotel a short walk from Gregory Lake

activities.name: Tea plantation and factory visit
activities.description: A stop at a working estate to see the leaves rolled and fired, with a cup of fresh Ceylon tea at the end.

activities.name: Gregory Lake and Nuwara Eliya town
activities.description: A half day around the lake, the racecourse and the colonial post office and market of the town.

program.name: Nuwara Eliya
program.description: Up through the estates with a tea factory stop for a night in the cool of Little England.

stops.name: Ella
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Twin sharing room · 3★ · Guesthouse style hotel with views down the Ella gap

activities.name: Little Adams Peak hike
activities.description: An easy early morning walk through the tea to a ridge with views down the Ella gap to the plains.

activities.name: Nine Arches Bridge
activities.description: The colonial railway viaduct in the jungle, timed for a train crossing if the schedule allows.

activities.name: Ravana Falls and Ravana Cave
activities.description: The wide roadside waterfall of the Ramayana legend and the cave above it.

program.name: Ella
program.description: Two nights in the hill town everyone falls for, with a full day of its viewpoints, bridge, falls and cave.

stops.name: Mirissa
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Twin sharing room · 3★ · Beachside hotel a few steps from the sand

activities.name: Coconut Tree Hill at sunset
activities.description: The palm topped headland at the end of Mirissa beach, best at the golden hour.

activities.name: Galle fort walk
activities.description: An afternoon inside the Dutch fort: the ramparts, the lighthouse, the old church and sunset from the walls.

program.name: Mirissa
program.description: Two nights on the south coast with Coconut Tree Hill at sunset and an afternoon at the Galle fort.

stops.name: Colombo
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Twin sharing room · 3★ · City hotel close to Galle Face Green

activities.name: Bentota boat safari
activities.description: A boat through the mangroves and islands of the Bentota river, with monitor lizards and water birds along the banks.

program.name: Colombo
program.description: A boat safari on the Bentota backwaters on the way up to the capital for the last night.

expert.name: Aditya
expert.role: Sri Lanka expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Sigiriya, Ella and Mirissa in one week is the route I recommend to every first timer under forty. Heritage, hills and the sea in that order.
expert.tip: Climb Sigiriya before breakfast. The gates open at seven, the steps are in shade and you are back down before the heat and the crowds arrive.

summary: Eight days with a small group and a trip captain: a dawn climb of Sigiriya, the Dambulla caves and a tea factory, a night in Nuwara Eliya, two in Ella for Little Adams Peak and the Nine Arches Bridge, two on the beach at Mirissa with Galle fort, and a Bentota boat safari on the way to Colombo.
included: Included: 7 nights in comfortable hotels on twin sharing; breakfast from day 2 and dinner on days 1 and 2; an air conditioned coach with English speaking chauffeur; a Hi Tours trip captain throughout; the guided Sigiriya rock climb; Dambulla cave temple and tea factory entrances; the Bentota boat safari; airport pick up on arrival; bottled water on tour days.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Sri Lanka ETA visa fees; GST and TCS; lunches and dinners unless stated; whale watching and water sports; the departure airport transfer; travel insurance; tips and personal expenses. Group departures are for travellers aged 16 to 42; ask us about a private version for other ages.
